checkedAlternates.risk: Homophone and Homonym are closely related.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Homophones share pronunciation with different spellings/meanings (group-1), whereas homonyms share both form/spelling and sound (group-4).
Meronymy is a strict part-of-whole lexical relation (group-3), whereas metonymy is figurative substitution by association (group-4).
